Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding repair and reuse of electronic products by registered collectors.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to repair and reuse of electronic products byregistered collectors; and adding a new section to chapter 70.95N RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.95N RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Only an entity registered as a collector with the departmentmay act as a collector in a plan. All covered electronic productsreceived by a registered collector must be submitted to a plan. Fullyfunctioning computers that are received by a registered collector inworking order may be sold or donated as whole products by the collectorfor reuse. Computers that require repair to make them a fullyfunctioning unit may be repaired onsite at the collector's place ofbusiness by the registered collector for reuse according to itsoriginal purpose. (2) Registered collectors may use whole parts gleaned fromcollected computers or new parts for making repairs as long as there isa partforpart exchange with nonfunctioning computers submitted to aplan. p. 1 SHB 1522 (3) Registered collectors may not include computers that aregleaned for reuse in the weight totals for compensation by the plan. (4) Registered collectors must maintain a record of computers soldor donated by the collector for a period of three years. (5) Registered collectors must display a notice at the point ofcollection that computers received by the collector may be repaired andsold or donated as a fully functioning computer rather than submittedto a processor for recycling.
